text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordan celebrates on Tuesday the Grand Arab revolt against the Turks and Army Day; the king patronises the celebrations of the armed forces on the occasion.
- PLO leader Yasser Arafat and Prime Minister Abdul Salam al-Majali discuss the state of the peace process; talks emphasise support for Palestinians and enhanced coordination.
- King Hussein and the Israeli opposition leader Ehud Barak discuss means of overcoming obstacles facing the peace process.
- King starts on Tuesday a European tour to include Britain, France and Italy to bolster bilateral ties and the Middle East peace process.
- Israeli witnesses testify in the trial of the Jordanian soldier who shot seven Israeli schoolgirls last March.
- Jordan plans to expand the foreign ownership ceiling on ownership of stock beyond an existing 50 percent limit to help attract more outside investments.
- Making history, six Israelis testify at the trial of the Jordanian soldier; ten more on Sunday. Defence loses bid to disqualify witnesses.
